summary: Ported Unity CarSteering architecture into Three.js: speed-dependent angle curve (0km/h: 35°, 60km/h: 22°, 120km/h: 10°, 200km/h: 5°), asymmetric steer (150°/s) and fast return-to-center (280°/s), Ackermann geometry, automatic counter-steer assist, and aerodynamic downforce & anti-roll stability.
